Prepaid & Postpaid Plan Lifecycle Policy

Document ID: Policy_C02_plan_lifecycle

Category: C02 — Plans & Subscriptions

Department: Product

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

This policy governs the lifecycle of prepaid and postpaid plans, including activation, validity, renewal, and expiry-related service treatment.

2. Policy Statements

Prepaid plan validity begins at the moment of successful activation and is fixed for the stated duration (e.g., 28/56/84/365 days).

On expiry, outgoing services are suspended; incoming services continue for a grace period defined by plan type and licence conditions.

Postpaid plan changes take effect either immediately (with pro-rated charges) or from the next billing cycle, per the customer's selection at the time of change.

3. Exceptions

Enterprise pooled plans follow the terms of the signed commercial agreement, which may override standard individual-plan lifecycle rules.

4. Review Cycle

This policy is reviewed annually or upon material regulatory change, whichever is earlier.
